evidence: Reads a context pointer from global 0x7003abf000+0xa98 and examines its +0x18c word; it may also resolve an object and examine its +0xc0 word. The output is 2 only when the global word equals 1 or the resolved-object word equals 3, and the final attribute-context selector-0x13 status is not 8; otherwise output is 0. The final status check overrides the intermediate status-8 path. decompiled/main/main_0076.c:17718-17745. No indexed caller is available; the object/global field meanings and resolver semantics remain unresolved.

Keeps the output pointer from x0, obtains status through get_attribute_context_status_32, transforms its low byte through f_70007464c8, then calls f_70008e0510 and conditionally f_70008e1848. If the resulting predicate bit is set it writes 2. Otherwise it initializes output to UINT32_MAX and, for x20 values 1..7 selected by mask 0x55, reads a 32-bit value from table address 0x7001d9ecf8+(x20-1)*4 and writes it; all other values retain UINT32_MAX. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:4083-4108. Helper meanings beyond their visible returns remain unresolved; no indexed caller is available.

Initializes the output to UINT32_MAX and reads a context pointer from global slot 0x7003b25000+0x460. It checks bit 26 of the 64-bit value at context+0x26584; if set it returns with the sentinel. Otherwise it resolves the optional attribute object from global slot 0x700227d000+0xda0, calls f_700183f6e4 when the nested pointer at +8 is absent, reads accepted player_attribute_get_float selector 0x17, converts the float to a signed integer, and stores it to the output. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:22476-22505. No indexed caller is available.

Queries accepted attribute_context_status_value_get with selector 0x13 three times. It returns immediately when the status is nonzero and not 3 or 4. For status 0, 3, or 4 it calls f_7001812c90 with (10, 0xffff, 0xffff); if that predicate is true, it loads the global pointer at 0x7002280000+0xc80 and calls f_70007aa010(pointer, 0x36, 0), then returns zero. The downstream helper purpose is unresolved. decompiled/main/main_0058.c:17432-17463. No indexed caller is available.

Subtracts 0x10 from incoming x0 and tail-calls the accepted classify_context_state_from_status_21_and_0x48 helper with the adjusted pointer; the wrapper performs no other guest-state operation. decompiled/main/main_0121.c:25961-25966. No indexed caller is available.
